summary: IDS feed s166_triple is degraded: 3 faults found - 8.5% oversize frames dropped by 1518B NIC, 3.93 Gbps bursts overloading 1 Gbps port (393% capacity), and 21.2% VXLAN-encapsulated traffic hiding inner payload from IDS inspection.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker is forwarding jumbo frames (up to 8108 bytes) from network segments configured for ~9000B MTU directly to a standard 1518B IDS port without MTU normalization. The IDS NIC drops anything >1518B at hardware level.
findings.impact_on_tool: 246 of 2894 frames (8.5%) are silently dropped by NIC before IDS processing. IDS has blind spot for large frames - misses attacks, data exfiltration, and full flow reassembly. Cannot use slicing because IDS needs_full_payload=true.

recommended_fix.why: IDS requires full payload so slicing would break detection. Must enable jumbo frames (9000-9216B) on IDS NIC/port and packet broker egress to deliver frames intact, or configure broker to fragment/normalize MTU upstream.

findings.root_cause: Single 1 Gbps IDS tool port is fed aggregated traffic from multiple sources without load balancing or rate policing. Bursts peak at 3.93 Gbps in 1ms intervals, 393% of port capacity across 9 intervals.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS buffers overflow and randomly drops packets during bursts. Results in incomplete flow records, missed signatures, TCP reassembly failures, and attacker can hide in burst-induced drops. IDS effectively blind during peak load.

recommended_fix.why: Distribute traffic across multiple IDS instances/ports or upgrade to 10G with load-balancing to keep per-port utilization <80% and prevent burst drops while preserving both directions per flow.

findings.root_cause: 21.2% of traffic (613/2894 frames) is VXLAN-encapsulated and packet broker is forwarding outer tunnel headers without stripping/decapsulating. IDS has no VXLAN decapsulation configured.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS only sees outer VXLAN/IP/UDP headers, not inner Ethernet/IP payload where attacks live. Signatures, anomaly detection, and lateral-movement detection fail for all overlay traffic - 1/5 of traffic is opaque.

recommended_fix.why: Configure packet broker to strip VXLAN headers and forward inner frames to IDS so IDS can inspect actual workload traffic and apply detection policies.
